Feb 24-25 appointments; Feb 26-27 Northampton, Massachusetts.

Rest/'Bad' (taking it easy); tea at Maryland with Duke of Connaught.

Bourget(?) dinner, Ojetti; Edie and Norton leave; tea with Bourget.
Reading (Gambetta, Pierre Mille, Cocteau); preparing return to Paris.
